report_name: New Black Lotus Ransomware Targets Windows Systems

threat_actors.name: Black Lotus group
threat_actors.description: The threat actor group operating the Black Lotus ransomware. The language in the ransom note suggests they target corporate networks for wider impact.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The primary function of the Black Lotus ransomware is to encrypt files on the victim's system to deny access and demand a ransom.

attack_patterns.name: Internal Defacement
attack_patterns.description: The ransomware changes the victim's desktop wallpaper to a notification informing them that their files have been encrypted.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The malware uses vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, preventing the victim from restoring encrypted files from local backups.

malware.name: Black Lotus
malware.description: A new file-encrypting ransomware family that targets Windows systems. It encrypts files, appends the .black_lotus extension, creates a ransom note named 'how2recovery.txt', and changes the desktop wallpaper.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery from local backups.

identities.name: Corporate Networks
identities.description: The Black Lotus ransomware operators are believed to target corporate networks for wider impact, as suggested by the language in the ransom note.

indicators.name: Black Lotus Ransom Note Creation
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Black Lotus Ransom Note Creation
id: 2b8c9a1d-e4f5-4b6c-8d7e-9f0a1b2c3d4e
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of the Black Lotus ransom note file 'how2recovery.txt'.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-20-nov-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-20
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\how2recovery.txt'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Black Lotus Wallpaper Defacement
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Black Lotus Wallpaper Defacement
id: 8d7e9f0a-1b2c-4d5e-a6f7-b8c9d0e1f2a3
status: experimental
description: Detects modification of the desktop wallpaper registry key, a technique used by Black Lotus ransomware to display its notification.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-20-nov-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-20
tags:
  - attack.t1491.001
level: medium
logsource:
  category: registry_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetObject|endswith: '\Control Panel\Desktop\Wallpaper'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Black Lotus File Encryption Pattern
indicators.pattern:
title: Black Lotus Ransomware File Encryption
id: 5e4d3c2b-1a0f-4e8d-9c6b-7a8f9e0d1c2b
status: experimental
description: Detects file rename events where the .black_lotus extension is added, which is characteristic of Black Lotus ransomware encryption activity.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-20-nov-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-20
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.black_lotus'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: c9d8e7f6-a5b4-4c3d-b2a1-f0e9d8c7b6a5
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware technique to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-20-nov-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-20
tags:
  - attack.t1490
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
